integrity: The proof uses the published range restriction to satisfying facets, the published self-selection property of Definition 5.1, and the internal-selection branch of Definition 5.2. It reconstructs the fixed-point class and derives idempotence and entailment absorption. The primary full text was inspected at the formal revision definitions and iterated-revision discussion; targeted literature searches did not locate these model-level laws.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the two basic factual revision operators in Definitions 5.1 and 5.2. It does not cover modal inputs or the later memory-enriched variants. Idempotence does not imply commutativity of distinct revisions.
title: Factual simplicial revision is an idempotent support retraction
